evidence.observedFact: The active booking site says all appointments require a card on file; cancellations without 24-hour notice are charged 50%, no-call/no-shows are charged 100%, and arrivals more than 10 minutes late are automatically canceled.
The live service menu offers recurring 2-week and 3-week lash fills and requires deposits on multiple full-set services, demonstrating an explicit repeat-appointment cadence.
Before/after-hours and squeeze-in appointments are available for an additional fee and customers are instructed to contact the business directly to schedule them.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate automated cancellation recovery, rebooking and appointment-protection workflows that complement the existing booking platform.
Automate due-back reminders and reactivation around the documented 2-week and 3-week lash-fill cadence.
Provide a structured follow-up workflow for direct-contact squeeze-in and after-hours scheduling requests.

recommendedEntryOffer: Lash Rebooking + Client Reactivation Revenue Engine
notes: Observed facts come from the business's active public booking site. Reactivation opportunity is based on the published recurring fill cadence; this does not assert that the business currently fails to retain clients or loses a specific amount of revenue.
